newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Bond purchases push Hungary O/N rates higher.
newsitem.headline: Bond purchases push Hungary O/N rates higher.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates ended higher on Thursday as customers sought funds to cover new bond purchases, traders said on Thursday.
Overnight rates closed at 21.75 percent after opening at 21.25. Wednesday's close was 21.375 percent.
"Now is the time for people to pay for the new five-year bonds issued last week," said Sandor Szatmari of Unicbank.
The average annual yield on Hungary's first ever issue of a five-year government bond last Thursday was set by auction at 15.69 percent.
The 2001/C bond bears annual interest of 15 percent, to be paid twice yearly starting June 12, 1997.
The only other factor which could raise rates further is the tax-payment deadline on February 10, traders said.
